product_metadata.title: Wilton EZ Thin Dipping Aid for Candy Melts Candy, 6 oz.
features: MADE EASY: Make dipping, drizzling and dunking Candy Melts candy easier with EZ Thin dipping aid. Just stir the crystals in to reach the perfect consistency for cake pops, coating pretzels and more.

BAKING ESSENTIAL: Use the bright white candy melts to dip strawberries, drizzle on pretzels or mold into shaped candies for parties and special occasions. EZ Thin will help you to achive the perfect consistency for your candy project
CONVENIENT: Get your Candy Melts candy to the perfect consistency with EZ Thin dipping aid; just stir in the crystals to thin candy for cake pops, pretzels and more

MORE FROM WILTON: Wide variety of candy molds and other tools so you can create treats for any occasion. Homemade candy makes a great gift, and it’s a fun way to spend time together when you’re looking for an easy and tasty activity to do!
CONTAINS: This Wilton product contains soy; made in a facility that also processes egg, fish, milk, tree nuts and wheat, contains bioengineered ingredients
description: Candy Melts EZ Thin is used for making candy wafers creamier and easier to work with. It is also odorless, as well as tasteless, so it will not change the smell and flavor of the dessert. Stir into melted candy for the ideal dipping consistency!.
